Effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 Digimon card with [Vegetation], [Plant] or [Fairy] in one of its traits and 1 [Yoshino Fujieda] among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
Inherited Effect: [Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When this Digimon would digivolve, if you have a green Tamer, reduce the digivolution cost by 1.
